tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main actions, selected state, links, focus ring, the active step. Reads 10.5:1 on background in dark, 5.4:1 in light.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (filled buttons, selected chips). 7.5:1 in dark, 5.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Soft emphasis: tonal buttons, selected list rows, info banners, the current setup step.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container. 7.6:1 in dark, 10.1:1 in light.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside a snackbar on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Positive confirmation: 'Keyboard ready', 'Saved', success ticks. Never the main action colour.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Success chips and banners ('✓ SmarType is on').

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Neutral-cool accent for secondary information: plan badges, metadata icons.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Neutral badges such as 'Free plan', 'Coming soon'.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page behind everything. Graphite-teal in dark, porcelain in light, true black on AMOLED.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Primary text on background. 15.3:1 in dark, 14.6:1 in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Same as background; the base the surface-container steps sit on.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on any surface or surface-container.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Track of switches and sliders, unselected chip fill.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row summaries, captions, helper text. 7.0:1 on surface-container-highest in dark, 5.4:1 in light.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Text fields and inputs that sit inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Grouped settings cards, list groups.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default card, top app bar when scrolled, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the raised card in a group.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Search fields, segmented control track, the highest tonal step.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered surfaces in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal sheet in light mode.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: outlined buttons, text field borders, focus-less inputs. 6.3:1 in dark, 4.2:1 in light.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and toasts.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, destructive actions (Sign out, Delete). Always paired with words.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning banner: something is limited, but nothing failed.

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-container.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets, at 32% opacity.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Keyboard AI gradient start (SmarTypeCyan). Keyboard and brand art only.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Keyboard AI gradient end (SmarTypeTeal). Keyboard and brand art only.

tokens.name: ai-gradient-start
tokens.usage: App AI gradient start (SmarTypeAppGradient). Only on AI actions: Rewrite, Translate, voice Done, Premium.

tokens.name: ai-gradient-end
tokens.usage: App AI gradient end.

tokens.name: on-ai-gradient
tokens.usage: Text and icons on either AI gradient, in every theme. 5.8:1 at the app gradient's start, 6.4:1 at its end, 7.5:1 on the keyboard gradient.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Rare. Splash or a single number on a hero.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: Large top app bar title when expanded.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Section headers in settings, panel headers in the keyboard.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Editor text (Write), AI results, long explanations.
styles.sample: I'll see you at the office tomorrow.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Badges and step labels. The smallest text in the app.

spacing.note: 4 dp grid. Values are dp in Android; shown as px here.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: chips in a row, buttons in a pair.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list; text block spacing inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, card padding, list row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter on wide phones (600 dp and up).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between sections; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a screen's primary button area; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height and width.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, small icon buttons, text selection (Shapes.extraSmall).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, text fields, icon buttons (Shapes.small).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every button, menus, snackbars, small cards (Shapes.medium).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped settings (Shapes.large).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheet top corners (Shapes.extraLarge).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only truly round things: avatars, status dots, switch thumbs.

shadow.note: Dark and AMOLED rely on tonal surface steps, not shadows. Light uses one soft shadow for raised layers only.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, top app bar at rest.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Menus and the FAB in light mode.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers: a layer of the content colour on top of the container.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover layer (keyboard and mouse users).

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Focus layer, together with the focus ring.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed layer and ripple.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Item being dragged (reordering styles, languages).

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons.

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill.

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.
